caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair set against a plain, light beige background. The chair features a spindle back with two vertical turned supports and a central, decorative back splat with a vase-like shape. The legs and horizontal stretchers are rounded, with three stretchers connecting the legs on each visible side, providing reinforcement. The seat of the chair appears to be woven from a lighter, straw-colored material. The wood of the chair is depicted in a warm brown tone with varying shades, showing the grain and texture. The overall composition centers the chair on the canvas, with no additional objects or decorations present.
title: Queen Anne Chair
